- [RCTS.1.2.20] **`expect.splice_field`** (optional, `rfcs_roundtrip` only) — an
  integer: the field number of the unknown atom a harness splices into the
  recording after its `StreamHeader`. Absent, it is 2000. A harness must fail a
  fixture whose `splice_field` is outside the skip band, 256 through 2047
  ([RFCS.16.2]), or is a field of `Atom`'s `oneof body`, because the spliced
  atom would then be read as one the reader knows and not skipped
  ([RFCS.16.3]). A number `proto/atom.proto` lists as `reserved` is admitted:
  a retired or deferred atom's number is what the field is for. A harness must
  fail a fixture of any other `expect.kind` that carries the field.
